babylon-park-london:considerations.durat.text: Duration varies depending on the ticket purchased; the venue recommends allowing 2 hours.
babylon-park-london:considerations.durat.was: A visit takes about two hours.

battersea-park:activities.childrens-zoo.text: A children's zoo is listed among the park's features.
battersea-park:activities.childrens-zoo.was: A children's zoo is listed among the park's features. Nothing else is said about it on the council pages.

discover-childrens-story-centre:activiti.text: A Baby and Toddler Sensory Story Space dedicated to 0-2 year olds, free with your Entry ticket; timed 45-minute sessions should be booked.
discover-childrens-story-centre:activiti.was: A play space for 0 to 2 year olds only (free with an Entry ticket; book a 45 minute session). Older siblings have a small craft area.

discover-childrens-story-centre:activiti.text: Luna Loves London immersive exhibition, open now, age guide 0-8, duration 50 mins, every day at various times.
discover-childrens-story-centre:activiti.was: Luna Loves London immersive exhibition, age guide 0 to 8, 50 minutes (add-on ticket).

discover-childrens-story-centre:pushchai.text: Buggy storage is available in the basement and/or garden; many spaces cannot have buggies in.
discover-childrens-story-centre:pushchai.was: Buggy storage on the ground floor, and in the basement or garden.

discover-childrens-story-centre:pricing..text: The Annual Entry tickets page says 0-1 year olds receive free tickets.
discover-childrens-story-centre:pricing..was: Babies under 1: one page says "0-1 year olds ... receive free tickets", the FAQ says under-1 tickets are "discounted".

gunnersbury-park:access.stepFree.text: Step-free access throughout the museum (some ramps and slopes); lift access to the first and second floors (all museum levels); a wheelchair to borrow on request.
gunnersbury-park:access.stepFree.was: Step-free access throughout the museum (some ramps and slopes); a lift to all levels; a manual wheelchair to borrow.

gunnersbury-park:pricing.free.text: The museum and park are free to enter; the car park has usage fees, though parking for blue badge holders in the designated disabled bays is free.
gunnersbury-park:pricing.free.was: The museum and park are free to enter; car parking is charged.

horniman-museum-and-gardens:toilets.acce.text: There are inclusive toilets in the Museum, Gardens and Café; the Museum does not provide hoists or adult changing facilities.
horniman-museum-and-gardens:toilets.acce.was: Accessible toilets in the museum, the gardens and the café; no hoists or adult changing.

horniman-museum-and-gardens:opening.clos.text: The Nature Gallery and Nature Discovery Den will be closed until 5 February 2027 for the Nature + Love project.
horniman-museum-and-gardens:opening.clos.was: The Natural History Gallery is closed for refurbishment; the Nature Gallery and Nature Discovery Den are closed until 5 February 2027.

horniman-museum-and-gardens:pricing.paid.text: Aquarium £2 to £16.80 and Butterfly House £2 to £28.60; children under 3 may visit free of charge but must book into a timeslot.
horniman-museum-and-gardens:pricing.paid.was: Aquarium £2 to £16.80 and Butterfly House £2 to £28.60 (the low end is the Universal Credit price); children under 3 may visit free but must book a timeslot.

london-zoo:activities.zootown.text: ZooTown is an indoor role-play adventure aimed at children aged up to 8; tickets must be booked online in advance; Silver members and non-members pay £1 per child.
london-zoo:activities.zootown.was: ZooTown is an indoor role-play adventure aimed at children up to 8; every child is welcome. Book online; £1 per child for non-members.

london-zoo:food.cafe.text: A Barista Bar next to The Terrace Restaurant serves coffees and hot drinks from 10am until the Zoo closes; The Terrace Restaurant is open 11.30am-2.30pm year round.
london-zoo:food.cafe.was: The Terrace Restaurant, Peckish Parrot Café, a Barista Bar and kiosks.

london-zoo:access.steep-slopes.text: The slopes leading to the two tunnels in the Zoo are steep.
london-zoo:access.steep-slopes.was: The slopes to the two tunnels are steep (relevant to pushchairs).

mudchute-park-and-farm:access.wheelchair.text: Most areas of the farm are accessible by wheelchair, though not all paths are tarmac; some ground can become muddy during and after heavy rain.
mudchute-park-and-farm:access.wheelchair.was: Most areas wheelchair accessible; muddy after heavy rain.

mudchute-park-and-farm:opening.hours.text: Farm open every day 9am to 4pm (animals go in from 3pm); park open every day dawn to dusk.
mudchute-park-and-farm:opening.hours.was: Farm open every day 9am to 4pm (animals go in from 3pm); park dawn to dusk. Pets corner and courtyard are closed on Mondays outside school holidays.

mudchute-park-and-farm:considerations.mo.text: The Main Courtyard is closed on Mondays except during school holidays, and there is no access to the Mudchute toilets when the courtyard is closed.
mudchute-park-and-farm:considerations.mo.was: The main courtyard (with the toilets and baby changing) is closed on Mondays outside school holidays, so there is no toilet access.

mudchute-park-and-farm:considerations.hy.text: Visitors are encouraged to wash their hands thoroughly after touching any animals (and are asked not to touch young lambs during lambing).
mudchute-park-and-farm:considerations.hy.was: Wash hands after touching animals; pregnant visitors are advised not to touch pregnant ewes, goats, lambs or kids.

natural-history-museum:transport.parking.text: No general parking facilities on site and parking around the museum is limited; a very limited number of on-site spaces are available for Blue Badge holders, booked in advance.
natural-history-museum:transport.parking.was: No parking on site, and parking around the museum is limited.

natural-history-museum:pricing.free.text: A free entry ticket can be booked to skip the queue on arrival; some exhibitions are paid.
natural-history-museum:pricing.free.was: The galleries are free to explore; a free entry ticket is recommended to guarantee entry. Paid exhibitions are charged.

raf-museum-london:access.wheelchair.text: Wide aisles throughout the hangars make access easy for wheelchairs and pushchairs; a limited number of manual wheelchairs and mobility scooters can be borrowed free, weather permitting, on a first-come, first-served basis.
raf-museum-london:access.wheelchair.was: Wide aisles in the hangars suit wheelchairs; manual wheelchairs and mobility scooters can be borrowed free.

raf-museum-london:opening.theatre.text: The 4D Theatre is temporarily closed for refurbishment.
raf-museum-london:opening.theatre.was: The 4D Theatre is temporarily closed for refurbishment until 31 December 2026.

raf-museum-london:pricing.free.text: Admission to all areas of the Museum is free, and donations are welcome.
raf-museum-london:pricing.free.was: Admission to all areas is free; donations welcome. Parking is charged.

science-museum:access.stepFreeRoute.text: A free guide for families with children under seven follows a step-free route through the museum, with five experiences for toddlers and young explorers.
science-museum:access.stepFreeRoute.was: A step-free route for families with under-7s links the toddler galleries.

science-museum:access.mezzanine.text: Currently there is no step-free access to the mezzanine level in the Making the Modern World and Flight galleries.
science-museum:access.mezzanine.was: No step-free access to the mezzanine in Making the Modern World and Flight.

science-museum:pricing.free.text: Admission is free: a free admission ticket can be booked; donations are welcome.
science-museum:pricing.free.was: Free admission with a pre-booked ticket. Wonderlab, Power Up, IMAX and the Bubble Explorers show are charged.

discover-childrens-story-centre:toilets..text: Toilets with baby changing facilities on all main floors.
discover-childrens-story-centre:toilets..was: Toilets with baby changing on all main floors. No facility to heat baby food or milk.

gunnersbury-park:toilets.accessibleToile.text: There is an accessible toilet in the museum and another in the park toilet block, which is near the museum.
gunnersbury-park:toilets.accessibleToile.was: Accessible toilets in the museum (ground floor, no RADAR key) and the park toilet block.

london-zoo:food.picnic.text: Outdoor picnic benches are available at the Peckish Parrot Café in the Animal Adventure area.

science-museum:pushchair.storage.text: Free buggy parking in the Spare Room (level -1, opposite The Garden; pushchairs must be empty), and a small free buggy park by Pattern Pod on level 0 for use while you visit that area.
science-museum:pushchair.storage.was: Free buggy parking in the Spare Room (level -1, opposite The Garden); a small free buggy park by Pattern Pod.

babylon-park-london:activities.rides-arc.text: Indoor rides including bumper cars, a carousel and a kiddie wheel, plus hundreds of games and VR experiences. No minimum age; the rollercoaster and drop tower have a minimum height of 105cm.
babylon-park-london:activities.rides-arc.was: Indoor rides including bumper cars, a carousel and a kiddie wheel, plus hundreds of arcade games and VR. No minimum age; the rollercoaster and drop tower have a 105cm height limit.

babylon-park-london:transport.station.text: Babylon Park is an 8 minute walk from Camden Road station.
babylon-park-london:transport.station.was: An 8 minute walk from Camden Road station; Camden Town (Northern line) is a short walk.

babylon-park-london:food.cafe.text: The Ovo & Neta restaurant on the Mezzanine floor serves a variety of food and drinks; vending machines are available throughout the park; outside food and drinks are not permitted.
babylon-park-london:food.cafe.was: Ovo & Neta restaurant on the mezzanine (pizza, hot dogs, ice cream, waffles); vending machines. No outside food or drink.

discover-childrens-story-centre:food.caf.text: A café on the ground floor; on busier days a coffee-and-snack shack in the garden is open.
discover-childrens-story-centre:food.caf.was: A café and bookshop on the ground floor; a snack shack in the garden on busier days.

gunnersbury-park:activities.park-museum-.text: A park with a museum and boating on the lake.
gunnersbury-park:activities.park-museum-.was: A park with a museum and a boating lake, and events for children and families. No age is given.

gunnersbury-park:transport.parking.text: Two car parks. Up to 30 minutes free if you register on the RingGo app or the machine (you cannot register for another free half hour for 2 hours after leaving); 30 minutes to 1 hour £1; longer than an hour £1 per hour. Charges apply at all times, including bank holidays. Blue Badge parking is free.
gunnersbury-park:transport.parking.was: Two car parks. The first 30 minutes are free; then £1 for 30 minutes to 1 hour and £1 an hour after. Charges apply at all times, including bank holidays. Blue Badge parking is free.

gunnersbury-park:food.cafe.text: The park café: weekdays 7am to 5pm, weekends 7am to 6pm.
gunnersbury-park:food.cafe.was: The Pure in the Park café: weekdays 7am to 5pm, weekends 7am to 6pm.

horniman-museum-and-gardens:activities.k.text: The Gardens Cafe is located next to the Kusuma Nature Play Area at the bottom of the Meadow Field.
horniman-museum-and-gardens:activities.k.was: Kusuma Nature Play Area, in the gardens, with its own toilets with baby changing, café and picnic tables. No age is given.

horniman-museum-and-gardens:food.cafe.text: The Horniman Cafe is open 9am to 5pm daily.
horniman-museum-and-gardens:food.cafe.was: The Horniman Cafe (9am to 5pm daily) and the Gardens Cafe by the nature play area.

london-zoo:activities.animal-talks.text: Daily animal talks, plus a schedule of upcoming events (no age given).
london-zoo:activities.animal-talks.was: Daily animal talks and events (no age given).

london-zoo:toilets.accessibleToilet.text: The zoo has a Changing Places toilet and a number of accessible toilets around the Zoo.
london-zoo:toilets.accessibleToilet.was: Accessible toilets around the zoo and a Changing Places toilet at Animal Adventure.

mudchute-park-and-farm:toilets.toilets.text: Toilets, including a disabled toilet, are available in the courtyard.
mudchute-park-and-farm:toilets.toilets.was: Toilets in the courtyard, including a disabled toilet. No access when the courtyard is closed (Mondays outside school holidays).

natural-history-museum:activities.dinosa.text: Roaring T. rex (in the Dinosaurs Gallery) and the museum's other star attractions are permanently on display and always free to visit. No age is given.
natural-history-museum:activities.dinosa.was: The Dinosaurs Gallery (Roaring T. rex) and the other star attractions are permanent and free. No age is given.

natural-history-museum:opening.hours.text: Open daily 10:00 to 17:50 (last entry 17:30). The page also lists closures on 9 October and 24 to 26 December.

raf-museum-london:activities.aeroplay.text: AeroPlay! is the museum's soft play area, next to the café in Hangar 4. No age is given.
raf-museum-london:activities.aeroplay.was: AeroPlay is the museum's soft play area, in Hangar 4 next to the café. No age is given.

raf-museum-london:play.softplay.text: AeroPlay! soft play is next to the café, which is in Hangar 4.
